text:
elaine: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR that bundles a private-install preflight checklist, a small migration note for VPC peering, and updated SDK snippets for KMS/HSM rotations. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/678 . Would appreciate a quick review today if possible.

jordan: Thanks — skimmed. Two quick asks: can we make the egress port matrix table a one-line summary (port ranges + purpose) and call out SNAT caveat for AWS NAT Gateway? The current table is a little noisy.

marie (security): Also we need an explicit callout about PKCS11 file perms + systemd unit override for selinux-enabled RHEL/CentOS. I can paste the SELinux policy snippet.

sam (eng): Small nit on the Node snippet — example needs an await on client.init() before calling rotateKey, otherwise examples trip new users. I'll paste a minimal corrected snippet below.

sam (eng): ```js
const { KmsClient } = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = new KmsClient({ endpoint: process.env.RW_KMS_ENDPOINT });
await client.init(); // important for remote HSM connections and key caching
await client.rotateKey({ keyId: 'proj-key-01' });
```

elaine: Nice — can you also add the note about retry/backoff for temporary HSM busy errors? Those surface in older firmware.

sam (eng): Yep — will add a short retry example and link to the HSM vendor doc. Something like: 

sam (eng): ```js
// simple exponential backoff
async function withRetry(fn, retries=3){
  let backoff = 200;
  for(let i=0;i<retries;i++){
    try{return await fn();}catch(e){ if(i===retries-1) throw e; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r, backoff)); backoff *= 2 }
  }
}
```

jordan: For the network preflight, can we add a one-liner conn-check that customers can run from the bastion before opening tickets? e.g., curl to control-plane and KMS endpoints with specific Host header.

elaine: Good idea — something like this?

elaine: ```bash
# from bastion: control plane + kms sanity check
curl -sS -I -H 'Host: control.redwood.internal' https://control-plane.internal:8443 | head -n1
curl -sS -I https://kms.internal:9443 | head -n1
```

marie (security): Add a note to blocklist inbound management on data-plane subnets. Customers often forget the least-privilege step after initial setup.

kai: I'm working on the migration guide for VPC peering -> Transit Gateway. I can add an annotated diagram and an example terraform snippet. Will push to the same PR branch if that's ok.

elaine: Sounds great — please keep the terraform snippet small (peering + route table example). Also add the 'rollback' quick-steps in case the route leak happens.

docs-lint-bot: linter found two link-check failures: docs/priv/vpc.md#peering -> 404; docs/examples/node-kms -> broken relative path.

elaine: I'll fix the link targets and fold the node example into docs/examples/kms/node.md to avoid relative breakage.

jordan: I can take the egress port summary and make a terse bullet list for the top of the matrix, then leave the full matrix below for advanced configs.

marie (security): I'll add the SELinux snippet and the PKCS11 chmod/ownership recommendation. Also add an example systemd drop-in for KMS agent when using HSM.

sam (eng): I'll push the Node + retry edits in a follow-up commit, and tidy the code fences so they render in the doc site.

elaine: Timeline: aim to merge by EOD tomorrow. If anyone needs more time, say so. Otherwise I'll coordinate final link-fix commit and merge. :thumbsup:

kai: okay for me. I'll aim to land the transit-gw tf snippet by EOD today.

jordan: I can finish the port-summary later this afternoon.

marie (security): I need until EOD tomorrow for the SELinux and systemd examples (testing on RHEL9).

elaine: That's fine — we'll hold merge until tomorrow noon UTC then. If any regressions pop from docs-ci we can revert.

elaine: One last ask — can someone sanity-check the example HSM error codes table? I put a short mapping of vendor codes -> recommended action. Would like a second pair of eyes.

sam (eng): I'll take a look after my meeting.

elaine: Thanks all — tagging @jordan @marie (security) @sam (eng) @kai for visibility. If you want me to split the PR into smaller pieces I can, but I kept related edits together to reduce churn.

jordan: no strong preference. single PR is ok if reviewers are aligned.

elaine: Cool — will update the PR description with the merge window and the docs-ci checklist.

docs-lint-bot: docs-ci: link-check passed on commit abc123, spellcheck flagged 1 term (pkcs11 lowercase).

elaine: I'll lowercase PKCS11 only where appropriate per style guide. Merge window still tomorrow noon UTC. Thanks everyone!
